data.bio: Betty, whose full name is Bethany Ann Smith, comes from a family with a rich naming tradition. Her great-great-grandmother was named Bethany, and her daughter was named Ann, creating a legacy that continues through the generations. Betty's grandmother Pauline and grandfather Simon had 16 children, though she only knows 4 of them: Joseph, Yuri, Kiko, and her mother Bobbie Sue. Betty works as a graphic designer and is passionate about art and design. She values her family history and the traditions that have been passed down through the generations.

education_entries.description: Graduated with focus on graphic design and visual communication.
